tasks.task: Find a popular recipe for a chocolate chip cookie and list the ingredients and preparation steps.
tasks.answer:
Popular recipe found: Best Chocolate Chip Cookies (Allrecipes, 19,331 ratings).

Ingredients:
- 1 cup butter, softened
- 1 cup white sugar
- 1 cup packed brown sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
- 1 teaspoon baking soda
- 2 teaspoons hot water
- ½ teaspoon salt
- 3 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 cups semisweet chocolate chips
- 1 cup chopped walnuts

Preparation steps:
1. Gather your ingredients, making sure your butter is softened, and your eggs are room temperature.
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Beat butter, white sugar, and brown sugar together in a large bowl with an electric mixer until light and creamy, about 4 minutes.
3. Beat in eggs, one at a time, then stir in vanilla.
4. Dissolve baking soda in hot water; add to batter along with salt and mix until combined.
5. Stir in flour just until no dry streaks remain. Fold in chocolate chips and walnuts, if using, until evenly distributed.
6. Drop rounded 1 ½-tablespoon portions of dough 2 inches apart onto ungreased baking sheets, using a medium cookie scoop if desired.
7. Bake in the preheated oven until the edges are lightly browned and the centers are just set, about 10 minutes.
8. Let the cookies cool briefly on the baking sheets, then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely.
9. Serve or store cooled cookies in an airtight container.

Recipe: Vegan Brownies

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 2 cups granulated white sugar
- ¾ cup good-quality unsweetened cocoa powder, sifted
- 1 teaspoon baking powder
- ¾ teaspoon salt
- 1 cup hot water or coffee
- ½ cup vegetable oil
- 2 teaspoons vanilla extract

Times:
- Prep Time: 15 mins
- Cook Time: 30 mins
- Additional Time: 10 mins
- Total Time: 55 mins
- Servings: 15

Preparation steps overview:
1. Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish with baking spray; line the bottom with parchment paper.
2. Whisk flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt together in a large bowl until combined.
3. Pour in water (or coffee), vegetable oil, and vanilla; mix until well-blended. Spread batter evenly in the prepared dish.
4. Bake in the preheated oven until the top is no longer shiny and the center feels just set when gently pressed, about 30 minutes.
5. Let cool for at least 10 minutes before cutting into 15 squares.

tasks.task: Search for a seafood paella recipe on Allrecipes with a minimum of 4.5 stars rating and at least 50 reviews. The recipe should include shrimp and mussels. Provide the ingredients, total time, and an overview of the preparation steps.
tasks.answer:
Final Response:
Recipe: Spanish Paella (Allrecipes) - https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/12728/paella-i/
Rating: 4.7 out of 5 stars with 178 ratings and 124 reviews (meets the minimum 4.5 stars and at least 50 reviews constraints)
Total Time: 1 hr 30 mins

Ingredients (includes shrimp and mussels):
- 4 tablespoons olive oil
- 1 onion, chopped
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 red bell pepper, chopped
- 4 ounces Spanish chorizo (cured spiced pork sausage), casing discarded and sausage cut into 1/4-inch dice
- 2 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into 1 inch cubes
- 1 (12 ounce) package uncooked Arborio rice
- 5 cups chicken broth
- 0.5 cup white wine
- 1 sprig fresh thyme
- 1 pinch saffron
- salt to taste
- ground black pepper to taste
- 2 squid, cleaned and cut into 1 inch pieces
- 2 tomatoes, seeded and chopped
- 0.5 cup frozen green peas
- 12 large shrimp, peeled and deveined
- 1 pound mussels, cleaned and debearded
- 0.25 cup chopped Italian flat leaf parsley
- 8 slices lemon, for garnish

Preparation steps overview:
1. Heat olive oil in a 14- to 15-inch paella pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic, and pepper; cook and stir for a few minutes. Add chorizo sausage, diced chicken, and rice; cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Stir in 3 1/2 cups stock, wine, thyme leaves, and saffron. Season with salt and pepper. Bring to the boil, and simmer for 15 minutes; stir occasionally.
2. Taste the rice, and check to see if it is cooked. If the rice is uncooked, stir in 1/2 cup more stock. Continue cooking, stirring occasionally. Stir in additional stock if necessary: use up to 2 cups additional stock, 5 cups total. Cook until rice is done.
3. Stir in squid, tomatoes, and peas. Cook for 2 minutes. Arrange prawns and mussels on top. Cover with foil, and leave for 3 to 5 minutes.
4. Remove the foil, and scatter parsley over the food. Serve in paella pan, garnished with lemon wedges.
